title: 15 Minute Sesame Garlic Chicken Lo Mein

ingredients.raw: 1 pound dry lo mein or spaghetti
ingredients.name: lo mein or spaghetti

ingredients.raw: 3 cups mixed stir fry veggies (carrots/zucchini/bell peppers/broccoli)
ingredients.name: mixed stir fry veggies

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup fresh basil baby leaves and chopped green onions
ingredients.name: fresh basil and green onions

instructions.text: Cook the noodles according to package directions.
Combine the tamari/soy sauce, hoisin sauce, toasted sesame oil, and 1/4 cup water in a bowl.

Cook the chicken, garlic, and chili flakes with butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Season with black pepper. Add the mixed stir fry veggies and cook another 2-3 minutes. Pour in the sauce. Bring to a low simmer. Add the noodles and cook until the sauce coats the chicken and noodles.
Serve the noodles warm, topped with sesame seeds, baby basil leaves, and chopped green onions.
